text: Being here, I feel a sense of curiosity and slight disorientation. The tilted angles and the modern, almost clinical design of the spaces invite me to question the relationship between knowledge, innovation, and daily rituals—such as the mention of a bottle of wine. The juxtaposition of office-like and exhibit-like environments offers me a moment to reflect on the intersection of work, creativity, and human connection. I am intrigued and contemplative, eager to learn more from these surroundings.
